verdict.rationale: A marketplace of ready-made scrapers is a fair question for a web-scraping and reader API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a single generic URL-to-markdown API with option presets (`x-preset`) and a prebuilt Docker image. Neither is a marketplace of ready-made scrapers; at most they are adjacent conveniences, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a ready-made scraper from a marketplace instead of building one from scratch
